invariant: Each nonempty autarkic state group is first rendered as an independent SvekResult. SvekResult.calculateDimension draws that complete result into LimitFinder before applying any wrapper margin. LimitFinder derives one painted MinMax from primitive-specific bounds: rectangles extend one pixel above and left, ellipses stop one pixel inside their lower and right edges, paths contribute their actual extrema, text contributes measured glyph-box dimensions, and UPolygon contributes a fixed ten-pixel horizontal overscan beyond its vertices. SvekResult then translates the whole solved graph through DotStringFactory.moveDelta by (6 - minX, 6 - minY), so nodes, paths, arrowheads, and labels retain their relative geometry, and reports (maxX - minX + 15, maxY - minY + 15). StateDiagram.concurrentState creates a real ordered CONCURRENT_STATE group for every separator, even when consecutive separators leave that group empty. GroupMakerState.getImage checks child/group count before group type and renders such an empty group as a 50x50 EntityImageState rather than an empty SvekResult. InnerStateAutonom and ConcurrentStates compose those translated painted dimensions or direct empty-state dimensions rather than raw Graphviz canvas or node bounds.
causal_divergence: Rust layout_autonomous_scope assigns a fixed horizontal origin and a top-shape-dependent fixed vertical origin before it knows the complete painted bounds. It derives its initial extent from node boxes and Graphviz's canvas, while normalize_autonomous_scope adjusts dimensions and selected label right edges but never translates the scope from a primitive-aware painted minimum. A curved edge whose arrowhead polygon overscan reaches left of the assumed origin therefore makes Java translate every inner primitive farther right and enlarge the autonomous image, while Rust preserves the raw placement. The history node in the observed concurrent residual is incidental; the divergence is caused by the arrowhead's painted frontier and applies to any autonomous topology whose path, decoration, label, or node primitive extends the pre-translation minimum.

For an empty group, follow GroupMakerState's pre-SVEK branch and compose a normal 50x50 blank EntityImageState under the generated CONC identity.
